source.name: BBC Science & Environment
source.title: Aviation faces hotter, stormier skies – and passengers might have to accept more disruption
source.summary: Are people going to have to increasingly accept more delays and diversions as the effects of climate change intensify?

lesson.title: Weather and air travel
lesson.overview: Could changing weather mean more problems for travelers?
lesson.prediction: Read the title. What do you think the story is about?
discussion: What happened? Start with: The report says ___.
Imagine a late bus or plane. Complete: While I wait, I can ___.
news_brief_sentences: Air travel faces hotter weather and more storms.
Climate change may cause more disruption to journeys.
Some planes might need to change their routes.

vocabulary.definition: a problem that interrupts normal activity
times when something happens later than planned
the ways used to travel from one place to another

grammar.explanation: Might need to means a change is possible. It does not say every plane will change its route.
grammar.example_quote: Some planes might need to change their routes.

quiz.question: What is the main question in this report?
options: Could changing weather cause more travel problems?
Will every flight stop permanently?
Have all passengers already changed their plans?
option_feedback: The report asks about possible disruption from changing conditions.
The report does not say every flight will stop.
The report does not say all passengers have changed plans.

quiz.question: Which pair of problems is mentioned?
options: Delays and changes of route
Lost passports and hotel prices
Longer holidays and new jobs
option_feedback: The source mentions delays and diversions.
These problems are not stated in the supplied summary.
These are not the travel problems described.

quiz.question: What is a route?
options: The way used to get from one place to another
The time when a shop opens
The amount paid for a ticket
option_feedback: A route is the way taken on a journey.
An opening time is not a route.
A ticket price is a cost, not a route.

quiz.question: Which sentence keeps the meaning of might?
options: A change of route is possible.
A change of route is certain for every flight.
A change of route is impossible.
option_feedback: Might expresses possibility.
This turns a possibility into an unsupported certainty.
Impossible contradicts the possibility expressed by might.
